[Verse 1]
Wraith oh! Cryptic
One I see
Black the veiled one
Chanting near
[D5]Bray high
songs of death
Call tombs
where they hide

[Riff 3]
[D5]

[Verse 2]
[D5]Sad dark hymns
in the air
black the covered one
roaming near
[D5]Winds chant
songs of death
Graves deep,
open wide
